name: Hornero Tailscale
description: Tailscale VPN status pill and dashboard card: connection state, tailnet IP, active exit node, online peers and one-click connect/disconnect toggle.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Gate Tailscale polling timers on root.visible and refresh dashboard card on show (HorneroOS/plugins#112).
Initial release: Tailscale status bar pill with popover and dashboard card showing connection state, Tailscale IP, active exit node, online peers and connect/disconnect toggle.

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between Tailscale status checks. Querying pauses in the Gaming experience.

showPeers.description: Show online peers in the dashboard card.

maxPeers.description: Maximum number of peers to list in the dashboard card.
